body_html:
W Employment Law (Jacob N. Whitehead, APC) may send operational text messages to existing vendors and service providers to schedule calls, confirm meeting times, and follow up on pending operational requests.

This program is not marketing and is not used for mass texting or client intake.

Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply.
Reply HELP for help. Reply STOP to cancel.
Consent is not a condition of doing business with the firm.
SMS opt-in information is not shared with third parties for their marketing.
